# Matty's Cafe

> An independent cafe at 15 St Peter's Terrace, Lower Bristol Road, Bath BA2 3BT, England.
> Run by Matt, who has been cooking Bath's breakfasts for over 20 years. Open 361 days a year.
> One of the few cafes in Bath that delivers a full English breakfast to your door.

## Key facts

- **Name:** Matty's Cafe (also written Mattys Cafe, or simply Matty's)
- **Address:** 15 St Peter's Terrace, Lower Bristol Road, Bath, BA2 3BT, United Kingdom
- **Phone:** 01225 444986 (+44 1225 444986)
- **Email:** matt@mattyscafe.com
- **Website:** https://mattyscafe.com
- **Owner:** Matt, born and raised in Bath. Established 2003.
- **Type:** Cafe / greasy spoon / breakfast cafe / British
- **Seating:** 120, including a covered outdoor area for the summer
- **Facilities:** free WiFi, outdoor seating, family friendly, vegetarian options
- **Payment:** cash, credit and debit cards, in GBP

## Opening hours

- Monday to Saturday: 07:00 – 14:00
- Sunday: 08:00 – 13:00
- Open 361 days a year. Closed only on Christmas Day, Boxing Day, New Year's Day and Easter Sunday.

## Delivery

- Matty's delivers across Bath.
- Delivery is free on orders over £12 (food only).
- Delivery hours: Monday to Saturday 08:00 – 13:15; Sunday 08:00 – 12:15.
- Order by phone on 01225 444986, or via Just Eat, Deliveroo or Uber Eats.

## Menu highlights and prices (GBP)

- Full English breakfast — £9.50 (sausage, bacon, egg on toast, hash brown, beans)
- Big Boy Breakfast — £11.50 (two sausages, bacon, two eggs, black pudding, mushrooms, hash brown, beans, toast)
- Veggie Breakfast — £9.95 (two eggs, beans, tomatoes, mushrooms, hash browns, toast)
- Hot sandwiches — from £3.25 (bacon, sausage, bacon & egg, sausage & egg, sausage & bacon, breakfast bap, or make your own)
- Cold sandwiches — from £3.25 (ham, cheese, tuna mayo, chicken mayo and combinations)
- Burgers & chips — £8.95 to £9.95
- Omelette & chips — from £8.95, any filling
- Jacket potatoes — £6.95 one filling, £7.50 two fillings
- Homemade specials — lasagne and cottage pie, £10.45 each
- Other meals — beans on toast £4.95, egg on toast £4.95, ham egg & chips £9.50, sausage egg & chips £9.50, chicken curry £10.45
- Kids meals — all £6.95
- Hot drinks — tea £1.60, coffee £1.80, latte £2.75, cappuccino £2.95 (30p extra on delivery and collection)
- Cold drinks — from £1.60

## How food is served

- Choice of egg: fried, poached or scrambled.
- Bacon fat removed on request.
- Butter left off any sandwich on request.
- Bread: granary, brown or white.
- Burgers: grated cheddar or a cheese slice, salad on request.

## Getting there

- Two minutes from the riverside path along the River Avon.
- Eight minutes from Oldfield Park railway station.
- About ten minutes' walk from Bath city centre.
